summary: Tuya Inc. filed a Form 6-K on May 11, 2026, reporting its unaudited first-quarter 2026 financial results and a next-day disclosure return regarding share capital changes and buybacks. The filing discloses routine quarterly earnings, including total revenue of $80.9 million (up 8.3% YoY), net profits of $15.8 million, and cash holdings of $1,017.1 million. There are no terms for a merger, acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, or any other special-situation event. The filing is a standard earnings release and share capital update for a foreign private issuer, with no deal terms or unusual corporate actions. The registrar is the issuer itself, and the content is purely operational and financial in nature, not triggering any special-situations category.
